exposure: methods of conception (IVF-ET vs. natural pregnancy)
serum albumin level before cesarean section
cohort: The study included 631 twin pregnancies with a gestational age of 28 weeks or more, all of whom delivered by cesarean section at Peking University People's Hospital.
finding: IVF-ET, a combined twin weight greater than 6000g, and serum albumin levels below 30 g/dl before operation were significantly correlated with an increased risk of severe postpartum hemorrhage in twin pregnancies delivered by cesarean section.
